_note: Indicative mapping of M365 control findings to related CVEs and NIST 800-53 controls. Associations are heuristic — the misconfiguration class relates to the CVE or control; they are not proof of exploitability in any specific tenant. Verify before citing to a client. CVSS scores are NVD base scores.

controls.title: Legacy authentication not blocked
remediation: Create a Conditional Access policy blocking all legacy authentication protocols for all users.
Run in report-only mode first and review sign-in logs for any remaining legacy clients.
Migrate remaining legacy clients (IMAP, POP3, Basic Auth) to modern authentication.
In Exchange Online, set-TransportConfig -AllowLegacyTLSClients $false.

controls.title: MFA not required for administrators
remediation: Create a Conditional Access policy requiring MFA (phishing-resistant preferred) for all privileged directory roles.
Exclude only two monitored break-glass emergency access accounts from the policy.
Review role assignments monthly and remove standing Global Administrator access.
Enable Entra ID Protection sign-in risk policies alongside MFA.

controls.title: MFA not required for all users
remediation: Extend the MFA Conditional Access policy to cover all users, not just admins.
Use the SSPR and MFA combined registration experience.
Allow a grace period for user enrolment before enforcing.

controls.title: Phishing-resistant MFA not required for admins
remediation: Configure Conditional Access to require Windows Hello for Business, FIDO2 security keys, or certificate-based authentication for all admin roles.
Exclude phishable MFA methods (SMS, voice) from admin authentication strength.

controls.title: Conditional Access policies not enforced
remediation: Move report-only Conditional Access policies to enforced after validating impact in sign-in logs.
Adopt a baseline policy set: MFA for admins, MFA for all users, block legacy auth, require compliant device.
Test each policy in report-only mode for at least 72 hours before enforcing.

controls.title: Excessive standing privileged role assignments
remediation: Enable Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and convert standing role assignments to eligible.
Require approval and justification for role activation.
Set maximum activation duration to 8 hours or less.
Review all Global Administrator assignments — target fewer than 5 permanent GAs.

controls.title: Guest invitations not restricted to admins
remediation: Set Guest invite settings to 'Only users assigned to specific admin roles can invite guest users'.
Configure cross-tenant access settings to restrict inbound collaboration.
Review existing guest accounts and remove stale or unnecessary access.

controls.title: Self-service password reset not configured securely
remediation: Enable SSPR with two authentication methods required.
Exclude phone/SMS as the only SSPR method — require app or email as secondary.
Monitor SSPR audit logs for suspicious activity.

controls.title: Entra ID Identity Protection policies not configured
remediation: Enable user risk policy: require password change when risk is High.
Enable sign-in risk policy: require MFA when risk is Medium or above.
Configure the combined security registration campaign.

controls.title: Audit log retention under one year
remediation: Extend unified audit log retention to at least 365 days (requires Purview Audit Standard or higher).
Export logs to a SIEM or Azure Storage Account for long-term retention and alerting.
Ensure audit logging is enabled for all workloads (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Entra).

controls.title: Audit logging disabled for one or more workloads
remediation: Enable unified audit log in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.
Verify all workloads are logging: Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID.
Set-AdminAuditLogConfig -UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled $true

controls.title: External email forwarding allowed
remediation: Disable automatic external forwarding in the outbound spam filter policy (AutoForwardingMode: Off).
Set remote domain AutoForwardEnabled to False for all remote domains.
Create a mail flow rule to block or alert on automatic external forwarding.
Alert on new inbox rules that forward or redirect externally.

controls.title: Safe Links not enabled or misconfigured
remediation: Enable Safe Links policy for all users covering email, Office apps, and Teams.
Enable 'Do not allow users to click through to the original URL'.
Enable 'Track user clicks' and review reports monthly.

controls.title: Safe Attachments not enabled or misconfigured
remediation: Enable Safe Attachments policy for all users in Dynamic Delivery or Block mode.
Enable Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams.
Set-AtpPolicyForO365 -EnableATPForSPOTeamsODB $true

controls.title: Anti-phishing policy not configured
remediation: Create an anti-phishing policy with impersonation protection for key users and domains.
Enable mailbox intelligence and intelligence-based impersonation protection.
Set phishing threshold to Aggressive (4) for high-risk environments.
Configure spoof intelligence and honour DMARC policy.

controls.title: DMARC policy not configured or not enforcing
remediation: Publish a DMARC record with p=quarantine as minimum; progress to p=reject.
Ensure SPF and DKIM are configured before enforcing DMARC.
Set up DMARC aggregate (rua) reports to monitor authentication failures.
Progress from p=none → p=quarantine → p=reject over 90 days.

controls.title: DKIM not enabled
remediation: Enable DKIM signing for all accepted domains in Exchange Online.
Use 2048-bit keys where supported.
Verify DKIM records are published in DNS for each domain.

controls.title: SPF record missing or misconfigured
remediation: Publish an SPF record for every sending domain: v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all
Use -all (fail) not ~all (softfail).
Keep SPF record under 10 DNS lookups.

controls.title: SharePoint external sharing unrestricted
remediation: Restrict tenant sharing level to 'New and existing guests' or 'Only people in your organisation'.
Limit external sharing to approved domains using the allow-list.
Set default sharing link type to 'Specific people' and default permission to View.
Require guests to authenticate before accessing shared content.

controls.title: SharePoint guest access expiry not configured
remediation: Set guest access expiry to 30 days or less.
Enable email reminders before guest access expires.
Review existing guest access permissions quarterly.

controls.title: Teams external access unrestricted
remediation: Restrict Teams external access to an allow-list of trusted domains only.
Disable Teams federation with consumer Skype accounts unless specifically required.
Review Teams external access policy and apply the most restrictive setting appropriate.

controls.title: Teams meeting security settings insufficiently restrictive
remediation: Set lobby bypass to 'People in my organisation' — anonymous users should wait in lobby.
Disable anonymous users from joining meetings without being admitted.
Prevent external participants from giving or requesting control.
Disable dial-in users from bypassing the lobby.

controls.title: Power Platform DLP policies not configured
remediation: Create at least one tenant-wide DLP policy in Power Platform admin centre.
Block high-risk connectors (social media, personal storage) from mixing with business data.
Classify connectors as Business, Non-Business, or Blocked.
Apply stricter DLP policies to environments containing sensitive data.

controls.title: Power Platform tenant isolation not enabled
remediation: Enable tenant isolation to prevent connectors from connecting to external tenants.
Use an allowlist of trusted tenants if cross-tenant connections are required.

controls.title: Device compliance policies not enforced via Conditional Access
remediation: Create Intune compliance policies for Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS.
Create a Conditional Access policy requiring a compliant device for all cloud apps.
Enable device enrolment for all user-owned and corporate devices.
Mark devices without a compliance policy as non-compliant.

controls.title: Password hash sync without pass-through authentication
remediation: Evaluate pass-through authentication or federation alongside password hash sync for on-premises policy enforcement.
Enable Entra ID Protection leaked-credential detection regardless of sync method.
Ensure seamless SSO is configured if using PTA.

controls.title: Too many Global Administrator accounts
remediation: Reduce Global Administrator count to 2–4 accounts maximum.
Assign least-privilege roles (e.g. Exchange Admin, User Admin) where GA is not needed.
Enable PIM for all remaining GA assignments.
Maintain two break-glass emergency access accounts excluded from Conditional Access.

controls.title: Admin accounts are not cloud-only accounts
remediation: Create cloud-only accounts for all privileged role assignments.
Do not sync on-premises admin accounts to Entra ID with privileged roles.
Enforce device compliance and phishing-resistant MFA on cloud admin accounts.

controls.title: Emergency access (break-glass) accounts not configured
remediation: Create two emergency access accounts with Global Administrator role.
Exclude break-glass accounts from all Conditional Access policies.
Secure with long random passwords stored in a physical safe, not a password manager.
Monitor break-glass accounts with alerts on any sign-in activity.
Test access quarterly without disrupting the monitoring alert.

controls.title: User consent for applications not restricted
remediation: Set user consent to 'Do not allow user consent' or restrict to low-risk verified publisher permissions.
Enable admin consent workflow so users can request access through an approval process.
Review existing OAuth app grants for excessive permissions.

controls.title: Third-party OAuth applications not reviewed
remediation: Review all app registrations and enterprise applications with delegated or application permissions.
Remove applications no longer in use.
Flag applications with Mail.Read, Contacts.Read, Files.ReadWrite.All, or similar broad permissions for review.
Enable Defender for Cloud Apps to monitor OAuth app behaviour.
